events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The iconic eleventh studio album by The Beatles, featuring tracks like 'Something' and 'Come Together', was released on this day in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' final recorded album, 'Abbey Road', changed music forever. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, known for her distinctive voice and rock anthems, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: From Akron to rock icon! Wishing a very happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The outspoken former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, and now successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Still rocking, still iconic. Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite tune from the Burnage legend?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic anthem of peace and hope, 'Imagine', was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975 to promote his 'Shaved Fish' compilation.

angles.name: Imagine Single Anniversary
angles.copy: A timeless message, a legendary song. John Lennon's 'Imagine' single hit UK shelves on this day in '75. Still resonates, doesn't it?

events.title: The first Apple iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music and paving the way for digital music players.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when your entire music library fit in your pocket? The original iPod launched 25 years ago today, changing everything.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating over 60 years of 007, James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred, and still thrilling after all these years! Happy James Bond Day to all the 007 fans out there.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the visionary co-founder of The Beatles and peace activist, John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... A true legend of music and peace, John Lennon would have been 86 today. His legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! A true comedy institution.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' sprawling and experimental double album, officially titled 'The Beatles', was released on this day in 1968, famously known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Minimalist cover, maximalist sound. The Beatles' legendary 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago today. What's your standout track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991 and would have celebrated his 80th birthday this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The show must go on... Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', a pivotal work in pop music history, was released on this day in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A turning point album that showed The Beatles' incredible evolution. 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today. A true gem.
